character.locked_description: An 8-year-old South Asian girl with a small build, warm brown skin, and a round face. Her straight black hair is tied back in a neat, low plait. She wears a mustard yellow (#E0B341) jumper with oversized sleeves pulled down to completely cover her hands, paired with fitted grey leggings and slate blue (#3B6D8C) slip-on shoes. Large grey noise-reducing headphones rest comfortably around her neck as an integrated accessory. A smooth grey pebble rests in her pocket, visible when she turns it with her fingers. At rest, she stands with a straight, measured posture, keeping her covered hands tucked close to her torso.
